data.case_title: Hunting license application rejected (Jagdschein) – insurance proof expired
data.explanation: This is a formal decision (Bescheid) from the hunting authority refusing to issue your three-year hunting license, because the liability insurance confirmation (Jagdhaftpflichtversicherung) you submitted had already expired. You do not need to file a new application: once you send a current, valid insurance confirmation, the license will be issued directly. You also have the right to file an objection (Widerspruch) against this rejection; the app will show you the deadline, which runs from when the letter is deemed delivered. If you take no action by then, the rejection becomes final. The information session on 25 December 2026 is optional and free. Consider seeking advice if you are unsure whether to object.

items.title: Decide whether to file an objection (Widerspruch)
items.action: Decide whether to file a written objection (Widerspruch), or declare it in person for the record, at Kreis Musterdithmarschen, Stiftstraße 8, 25746 Musterheide in Holstein, by the deadline shown.
items.consequence: If no objection is filed in time, the rejection becomes final.

items.title: Submit a current hunting liability insurance confirmation
items.action: Send a valid, up-to-date confirmation of hunting liability insurance (Jagdhaftpflichtversicherung) to the Kreis.
items.consequence: The hunting license (Jagdschein) will then be issued without a new application.
items.quote: Sobald Sie eine gültige Versicherungsbestätigung nachreichen, stelle ich den Jagdschein ohne neuen Antrag aus.

items.title: Optional information session on hunting license topics
items.action: Attend the voluntary, free open office hour if you want more information.
items.quote: Wer mehr über das Thema erfahren möchte, kann am 25.12.2026 unsere offene Sprechstunde im Bürgerhaus Ostweide besuchen; die Teilnahme ist freiwillig und kostenlos.

key_facts.quote: Der Nachweis, den Sie vorgelegt haben, ist am 30.06.2026 abgelaufen.
